items.title: Prospective, mechanism-led hypotheses on a loss budget
items.chose: every hypothesis is pre-registered with its mechanism and tested forward against a loss budget
over: retrospective sweeps: the lookahead fix showed how easily they flatter
evidence: the lookahead fix (13 Oct): every comparison re-run on corrected panels
H008 pre-registered and killed inside its budget

items.title: Abandon breadth-based strategies; pursue few, high-IC structural edges
items.chose: a few structural edges with high information coefficient, not a wide cross-section
over: ALT/XBT cross-rates for Bitcoin-factor neutrality: worth about 2.7 independent bets however wide
evidence: mean pairwise correlation 0.620 in USD, 0.366 in XBT (Kraken daily, 720 observations, 26 alts)
items.affects: closes the crypto cross-sectional route ADR-005 opened

items.title: Live trading cannot validate; neutrality is the only lever that can
items.chose: make strategies factor-neutral so that a short live record can say something
over: validating by live trading alone: too few independent observations
evidence: power calculation: years of live trading to separate a modest edge from zero

items.title: Which venue, frequency and position-size cells survive costs
items.chose: only the cells whose edge survives the cost model at retail size
evidence: cost-model.md: spreads, fees and impact per venue

items.title: Narrow the employer-adjacency exclusion to EM rates and EM FX
items.chose: exclude only EM rates and EM FX
over: excluding rates, EM, FX and discretionary macro wholesale (ADR-002): too broad

items.title: Deliberately avoid rates, EM, FX and discretionary macro
items.chose: stay clear of anything adjacent to an employer's book

items.title: Build the execution spine before the research platform
items.chose: the execution spine first: data in, orders out, a journal, before any research tooling
over: a research platform first: the lesson from the last five projects
